recaps.title: Winter Is Coming
recaps.safeSummary: Beyond the colossal icy Wall, rangers of the Night's Watch encounter mythical White Walkers. In Winterfell, Lord Eddard 'Ned' Stark receives a royal visit from his longtime brother-in-arms, King Robert Baratheon, who asks Ned to serve as the new Hand of the King following the suspicious death of Jon Arryn. Across the Narrow Sea in Pentos, exiled prince Viserys Targaryen arranges the arranged marriage of his younger sister Daenerys to Dothraki horselord Khal Drogo. Back at Winterfell, young Bran Stark climbs a derelict tower and accidentally witnesses Queen Cersei Lannister in an incestuous tryst with her twin brother Jaime, who pushes Bran out of the tower window.
bullets: White Walkers slaughter Night's Watch rangers beyond the Wall; Ned Stark executes the lone deserter.
The Stark children discover an orphaned litter of direwolf pups, one for each child.
King Robert arrives at Winterfell and asks Ned to become Hand of the King.
In Essos, Daenerys is gifted three petrified dragon eggs at her wedding to Khal Drogo.
Bran Stark climbs the old tower, witnesses Queen Cersei and Jaime Lannister, and is shoved from the window.

King Robert names Ned Stark Hand of the King
